description: Aménagements cyclables is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by EPT Plaine Commune. Location and typologies of existing cycling developments on the territory of Plaine Commune. Coverage: EPT Plaine Commune. The portal shows the English title as "Cycling facilities" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is EPT Plaine Commune. Its keywords include piste-cyclable, cycle, velo, mobilite-douce, piste, reseau-cyclable. The listing shows 2 download or service links in XLSX, CSV. The listing shows 2025-05-28 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/licence-ouverte-open-licence). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
